% Colors in math in a document with xcolor but not colortbl. colortbl has
% MathJax load its color extension up front; without colortbl, the
% \definecolor lines given to MathJax load the extension themselves. The
% math has a paired delimiter, after which a restart would lose the colors.
% graphicx is loaded because mathtools without it gives a false \a:Gin-dim
% warning.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,mathtools,graphicx}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\abs}{\lvert}{\rvert}
\definecolor{ink}{RGB}{200,0,100}
\colorlet{accent}{ink}
\begin{document}
In math, $\abs{x} + \textcolor{accent}{a} + \textcolor{green}{b} + \textcolor[HTML]{3366CC}{c}$.
\end{document}
